codemap:
skills/agent-brief/assets/backlog.mjs — the backlog CLI; its argument handling has to answer --help/-h on stdout with exit 0 while the unknown-command path keeps exiting 2 with the usage on stderr
skills/agent-brief/assets/backlog.test.mjs — the suite that pins every CLI behavior end to end; the help flag and the preserved error path are verified here

increments.title: backlog.mjs answers --help and -h
increments.goal: Asking the backlog helper for its usage works without provoking an error: the help flags print the usage to stdout and exit 0, and a wrong call keeps its exit-2 usage on stderr.
criteria: `node skills/agent-brief/assets/backlog.mjs --help` prints the usage to stdout and exits 0.
A call with an unknown command keeps exiting 2 with the usage on stderr.

steps.label: decompose

return.summary: The issue is one change, so the backlog holds one increment, help-flag, carrying all three acceptance criteria: --help prints usage to stdout with exit 0, -h behaves identically, and an unknown command keeps exiting 2 with usage on stderr. I rejected splitting the flags from the preserved error path because neither half is worth its own review chain. Depth is full: the flag behavior can only be proven by tests that do not exist yet. The codemap names the CLI, its end-to-end suite, and the doc describing that suite's coverage.

steps.prompt:
Issue directory: docs/issues/2026-08-10-backlog-help-flag
Open the run state for docs/issues/2026-08-10-backlog-help-flag/issue.md: map the issue against the codebase, decide the cut, and write both into docs/issues/2026-08-10-backlog-help-flag/backlog.json with the `init` subcommand of the backlog helper your shared brief names, with workflow "agile-loop" and the whole codemap in the payload's `codemap` field.
This run works at most 8 increments, so a cut that needs more than that is a cut that is too fine.
Announce this step before you begin it and record it before you return, the way your shared brief describes, with the backlog helper it names:
  - `start docs/issues/2026-08-10-backlog-help-flag/backlog.json - decompose <the prompt file>` — the prompt you were given, verbatim and whole, in a file outside the repository.
  - `record docs/issues/2026-08-10-backlog-help-flag/backlog.json - decompose <the return file> <the prompt file>` — your return, in a file outside the repository, with that same prompt file. Commit it with your work and push the commit.
The fields your return carries, and your page says what each one holds:
  - `questions`
  - `summary`
